name: Claude 1
note: Anthropic's first public model (API plus partners like Notion, Quora Poe, DuckDuckGo); Constitutional-AI-trained ChatGPT rival launched the same day as GPT-4.

name: Claude Instant
note: Faster, cheaper sibling released alongside Claude 1, the start of Anthropic's multi-tier lineup (ancestor of the Haiku line).

name: Claude 2
note: Launched claude.ai as a public beta (US/UK), Claude's consumer debut; 100K context and big gains in coding and math.

name: Claude Instant 1.2
note: API-only refresh of the fast/cheap model with Claude 2-era gains in math, coding and fewer hallucinations.

name: Claude 2.1
note: 200K-token context (largest on the market then), about 2x fewer hallucinations, system prompts and beta tool use.

name: Claude 3 Opus
note: First Claude to beat GPT-4 on most standard benchmarks; the Claude 3 family added image input and a 200K context.

name: Claude 3 Sonnet
note: Balanced mid-tier Claude 3 model that powered the free claude.ai experience.

name: Claude 3 Haiku
note: Fastest and cheapest Claude 3 model ($0.25/$1.25 per M tokens); shipped nine days after Opus and Sonnet.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
note: Mid-tier model that beat Claude 3 Opus at twice the speed and a fifth of the price; debuted Artifacts and became developers' favorite coding model.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new)
note: Upgraded 3.5 Sonnet (nicknamed '3.6'): big coding gains and the first frontier model offering computer use (public beta).

name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
note: Fast model rivaling Claude 3 Opus that beat GPT-4o on SWE-bench Verified; announced Oct 22, released to API/Bedrock/Vertex on Nov 4 (text-only).

name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
note: First hybrid reasoning model: instant answers or visible step-by-step extended thinking in one model; shipped with the Claude Code research preview.

name: Claude Opus 4
note: Claude 4 generation: billed as the world's best coding model, able to work for hours on agentic tasks; first model shipped under ASL-3 safeguards.

name: Claude Sonnet 4
note: Claude 4 mid-tier successor to 3.7 Sonnet, available to free users; chosen to power GitHub Copilot's new coding agent.

name: Claude Opus 4.1
note: Drop-in upgrade to Opus 4 for agentic tasks and real-world coding (74.5% SWE-bench Verified).

name: Claude Sonnet 4.5
note: Anthropic's frontier model at launch ('best coding model in the world'), outperforming Opus 4.1 at Sonnet prices and working autonomously for 30+ hours.

name: Claude Haiku 4.5
note: Small model with Sonnet 4-level coding at a third of the cost ($1/$5) and over twice the speed; first Haiku with extended thinking.

name: Claude Opus 4.5
note: Opus price cut by two-thirds ($5/$25) with state-of-the-art coding; first model above 80% on SWE-bench Verified.

name: Claude Opus 4.6
note: Upgrade to the top model: first Opus with a 1M-token context (beta), adaptive thinking with effort levels, and agent teams in Claude Code.

name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
note: Near-Opus coding and computer use at Sonnet price ($3/$15); became the default for Free and Pro users; 1M context (beta).

name: Claude Mythos Preview
note: LIMITED ACCESS: new tier above Opus, withheld from general release because it finds and exploits software vulnerabilities better than nearly all humans; available only to Project Glasswing partners (AWS, Apple, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA and others); system card published.

name: Claude Opus 4.7
note: Opus upgrade: SWE-bench Verified up from 80.8% to 87.6%, higher-resolution vision, and a new 'xhigh' effort level; Claude Design launched alongside it.

name: Claude Opus 4.8
note: Incremental Opus upgrade six weeks after 4.7: more honest about its own progress, lowest hallucination rate, longer independent work; fast mode made 3x cheaper.

name: Claude Fable 5
note: First Mythos-class model made safe for general use (Claude 5 generation, SOTA on nearly all benchmarks, $10/$50); a US export-control directive forced a worldwide suspension from Jun 12 to Jul 1, 2026.

name: Claude Mythos 5
note: LIMITED ACCESS: same underlying model as Fable 5 with some safeguards (cyber) lifted; restricted to Project Glasswing and trusted-access partners.

name: Claude Sonnet 5
note: Most agentic Sonnet yet, close to Opus 4.8 performance at a lower price ($2/$10, later made permanent); new default model for Free and Pro.

name: Claude Opus 5
note: Near-Fable 5 intelligence at Opus speed and price ($5/$25), about half the cost per task; 1M context with adaptive thinking by default.

name: Claude Fable 5.1
note: Upgrade of the top generally available model, billed as the world's most advanced for coding and knowledge work, with big gains in scientific research and long agentic runs; cache reads 75% cheaper.

name: Claude Mythos 5.1
note: LIMITED ACCESS: restricted counterpart of Fable 5.1 (same model, fewer safeguards) for vetted US cybersecurity and life-sciences organizations via trusted-access programs.

name: Claude Opus 5.5
note: First model of the Claude 5.5 family: Fable 5.1-level performance on most work at about 40% lower running cost than Opus 5 ($4/$20) and 30%+ faster output.
